data.name: Graphics Plus
data.shortDescription: Simple mod that allows you to choose an LOD multiplier
data.description:
In-game open the settings menu for the mod 
then adjust the sliders to whatever multiplier you want.

1x = Ultra Default.
4 x= 4x ultra draw distance.

this mod aims to reduce LOD pop-in, on my pc it roughly halves my framerate with all the sliders fully maxed out

This mod only affects objects that are  affected by the "LodManager" which means things such as player structures, some certain pieces of the world and enemies will not be affected.
